title: QUIC RFC 9308 Applicability Hardening Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, API/comment review, application-developer documentation review, qlog diagnostic mapping tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers the informational RFC 9308 hardening surface: public 0-RTT absence, keep-alive/resumption documentation, application stream mapping documentation, flow-control and stream-limit blocked-state preservation, application close-code propagation, NAT rebinding candidate non-promotion, qlog diagnostic mapping, connection-ID privacy boundary documentation, version deployment boundary documentation, and DATAGRAM applicability documentation.
preconditions: RFC 9308 remains classified as informational guidance.
The current public API does not expose application 0-RTT.
RFC 9000 path-validation, flow-control, stream-limit, and close behavior remains the owning protocol behavior.
RFC 9221 remains the only implemented DATAGRAM transport floor.
expected_result: Focused RFC9308 tests pass, qlog diagnostic mappings include flow-control and stream-limit blocked events, core SpecTrace validation accepts the new artifacts, generated requirement coverage includes the RFC9308 applicability family without breaking existing RFC 8999/9000/9001/9002/9114/9204/9221/9287/9368/9369 status, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: Focused RFC9308 verification passed in this branch: RFC9308 requirement-home tests passed 12/12; the combined RFC9308/RFC9312 focused filter passed 18/18; the qlog smoke filter passed 7/7; core SpecTrace validation accepted 619 JSON artifacts; generated coverage reports RFC9308 at 10/10 trace clean. Unsupported RFC 9308 guidance remains application-owned, not applicable, or deferred rather than represented as newly implemented transport behavior.
